grade_rationale.text: Afanasyev quotes Tugarin's roar as the testimony of Russian tales and byliny.
Afanasyev's Tugarin material is drawn from Kirsha Danilov's byliny and Sakharov's tales, which he summarises.
Ralston, writing of the Serpent in Russian tales, names Tugarin Zmyeevich among the heroes born of the Serpent's unions with mortal maidens.

Ralston's statement parallels Afanasyev's on p.578, but on this passage Ralston does not cite or quote Afanasyev (the page's one Afanasief footnote belongs to the Luna and Zvyezda story), so under the per-passage rule he counts as a second, independent source.
Both verified peoples_regions rows name Russians, and no other people is named for Tugarin: one people, two independent sources.
